$comment: Single source of truth for color. Render reads it for materials and effects; UI generates CSS variables from it. Roles, not names, are what code references. A key starting with $ is not a colour role: the generator (scripts/palette-css.mjs), the swatch harness and the role union all skip them, which is why the biome overrides below live under $biomes — the overlay must look the same in every biome, so they must not become CSS variables.
$biomesComment: Per-biome overrides of the roles above (D49). A biome names only what changes; every role it does not name resolves to the base list, so the gates, the spells and the UI are one family across the whole game. src/render/palette.ts applies them with setBiome().
